settings.heading: Anointing oils, made with care
settings.intro: Mount of Olives makes biblical anointing oils from 100% olive-derived squalane and antioxidant-rich botanical polyphenols. Every blend is formulated in Richmond, Texas, for prayer, worship, and daily care of the skin.

settings.heading: Made in Richmond, Texas
settings.text:
Our studio is in Richmond, Texas, just outside Houston. Every Mount of Olives blend is made there, from the first measure of squalane to the last label.

We make anointing oil for people who pray. That shapes every choice, from the botanicals we source to the way we seal each bottle.

settings.heading: Why olive, and why squalane
settings.text:
The olive runs through Scripture. Its oil anointed kings and priests, lit the lamps of the tabernacle, and gave its name to the hill where Jesus prayed. The psalmist wrote, "I am like a green olive tree in the house of God" (Psalm 52:8).

So our base is 100% olive-derived squalane, a lipid similar to the squalene in human skin. It carries every botanical extract in the blend and enhances its bioavailability.

settings.quote: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

settings.text: Each oil is carefully blended, tested, and bottled by hand in our Richmond studio. Our formulas are natural, paraben-free, and vegan, and every ingredient is derived from biblical botanicals.
